title: Fix missing BTC monthly liquidity zones and ensure untouched boxes persist/render deterministically

requirements.summary: Ensure monthly reversal-structure detection consistently emits the expected ~$27k–$25k lower untouched LiquidityBox and adds dev-only diagnostics when creation is skipped.
acceptanceCriteria: With the current production BTC monthly candle dataset loaded, at least one lower LiquidityBox is present whose bounds cover the ~$27k–$25k area (i.e., minPrice and maxPrice fall within that expected zone).
The ~$27k–$25k box renders on the chart in the neutral/untouched style (not active) when price has not entered it.

If a reversal structure is detected that should produce the ~$27k–$25k lower zone but box creation is skipped, a development-only diagnostic warning is emitted including oppositeStartIndex, endIndex, computed wick/body bounds, and the skip reason.

file_operations.description: Adjust monthly reversal-structure scanning to avoid premature end/cap behavior that can prevent lower-zone emission, and harden lower-box bounds derivation so valid wick-to-body ranges (including the ~$27k–$25k zone) are consistently produced when reversal structures exist.

Extend development-only skipped-box diagnostics to include computed body bounds (lowerBodyBound/upperBodyBound) alongside wick bounds and the skip reason, ensuring the warning payload contains oppositeStartIndex, endIndex, wick/body bounds, and reason.

Add a development-only sanity assertion that specifically checks for at least one lower untouched LiquidityBox whose bounds intersect the expected ~$27k–$25k zone when using the production BTC monthly dataset, to catch regressions early without affecting production behavior.

requirements.summary: Guarantee untouched liquidity boxes (touchCount===0) are never removed/suppressed by recomputation, filtering, or replacement; add dev-only warnings when a box cannot be plotted.
acceptanceCriteria: For every LiquidityBox with touchCount===0, the algorithm returns state==='untouched' and the chart renders it (no missing boxes due to coordinate/index resolution).

No code path removes or filters out boxes solely because they are old, far from current price, or replaced by newer structure (unless they have been touched and then clearly cleared per the existing rules).

When a box cannot be rendered due to coordinate resolution failure, a development-only warning is logged that includes the box identifiers (minPrice, maxPrice, candleIndex, isUpper, state) and the resolved indices used for rendering.

file_operations.description: Refactor lifecycle evaluation into exported helpers so previously-emitted boxes can be re-evaluated against the latest candles and only removed when 'touched+cleared' criteria are met; ensure no time/distance/trend/structure replacement logic suppresses boxes with touchCount===0.

Persist and merge liquidity boxes across recomputations (e.g., when candles append/refetch) so untouched boxes remain present even if newer structure detection would otherwise omit them; re-evaluate persisted boxes against the latest candles and drop only those that become 'cleared'.

Ensure all non-cleared boxes are rendered and add development-only rendering warnings when coordinate resolution fails, including minPrice, maxPrice, candleIndex, isUpper, state, and the resolved start/end indices used for plotting.

requirements.summary: Make liquidity box rendering deterministically map x-axis coordinates by candleIndex (clamped) and never drop valid boxes due to lookup failures; use stable React keys to prevent flicker.
acceptanceCriteria: All boxes returned by the liquidity algorithm render as ReferenceArea overlays unless their state is 'cleared' (which must not be returned/rendered).
Boxes with candleIndex < 0 render starting at the first candle; boxes with candleIndex > last index render starting at the last candle; in both cases they extend to the latest candle.
Rendering uses stable React keys that prevent flicker/re-mounting when new candles load (keys include isUpper + candleIndex + bounds).

file_operations.description: Update ReferenceArea x1/x2 mapping to be strictly candleIndex-based with clamping and guaranteed fallback to nearest valid candle label; replace idx-based keys with stable keys derived from isUpper + candleIndex + minPrice + maxPrice; ensure dev-only warnings (not production) when x-axis coordinate resolution fails.
Add development-only invariants ensuring no non-cleared boxes are dropped before rendering and that box candleIndex values are normalized/clamped consistently for rendering expectations.

requirements.summary: Add a deterministic developer regression fixture (minimal hard-coded candles) that reproduces missing lower-zone behavior and verifies box emission/persistence/clearing lifecycle.
acceptanceCriteria: A new development-only test/fixture (run in the frontend build/test environment) asserts that the computed liquidity model includes at least one lower LiquidityBox for the fixture sequence.
The fixture asserts untouched boxes remain in the returned model across recomputation when additional candles are appended that do not touch the box.
The fixture asserts a box is removed only when the fixture includes a confirmed touch followed by clear displacement satisfying the existing cleared criteria.

file_operations.description: Create a minimal hard-coded monthly candle sequence designed to trigger the two-consecutive-opposite reversal structure and produce a lower wick-based liquidity range representative of the missing lower-zone scenario.

Implement a development-only regression runner that computes the liquidity model on the fixture sequence, uses deterministic assertions (e.g., throwing or console.assert/console.error) to verify: (1) at least one lower box is emitted, (2) untouched boxes remain after appending non-touch candles, and (3) boxes are removed only after touch+clear criteria are satisfied.
Wire the regression fixture runner to execute only in development builds (guarded by import.meta.env.DEV) so it runs in the frontend dev/test environment without impacting production behavior.
